items.// required-note: OpenAI's structured-output API rejects any schema whose `required` omits a key present in `properties` — codex once returned HTTP 400 invalid_json_schema ('Missing line') on a schema that omitted a property from required. Keep this list exhaustive: adding a property without adding it here silently kills the codex lanes again.
